products.title: Organic Stretch Biker Short
products.body_html:
A classic biker short made for low-impact movement, lounging, and everyday wear.

A close-to-body fit and 6" inseam offer smooth, supportive comfort, while organic cotton with a touch of stretch moves naturally with the body. Soft and breathable against the skin, it’s designed to go well beyond the workout. Studio-bound, street-ready, couch-approved.

Dress Code
GOTS certified organic cotton. OEKO-TEX® certified for human health. The Climate Label certified for reduced environmental impact. Certified B Corp for social and environmental accountability.
 
- Made with 92% Organic Cotton, 8% Spandex
- GOTS Certified Organic Cotton
- Machine wash cold with like colors
- Tumble dry low
- Do not bleach
- Made in India

Please note that there can be slight differences in the coloration of our products across different fabrications. To ensure no color discrepancy in your set, we recommend that you opt for purchasing a set in the same fabric.
Inseam ALL 6"
XS: Waist 20 1/4; Hip 26"; Front Rise 9 1/8
S: Waist 22 1/4; Hip 28"; Front Rise 9 1/2
M: Waist 24 1/4; Hip 30"; Front Rise 9 7/8
L: Waist 26 1/4; Hip 32"; Front Rise 10 3/8
XL: Waist 28 1/4; Hip 34"; Front Rise 10 7/8

products.title: Organic Stretch Cami Unitard
products.body_html:
A fitted one-piece designed to move with you through every part of the day.

A second-skin silhouette is crafted from soft, breathable organic cotton with a touch of added stretch and finished with an interior shelf bra for light, built-in support. Smooth against the skin and naturally flexible, it moves easily from workouts to errands to slower days at home. Sleek, versatile, effortlessly pulled-together.

Dress Code
GOTS certified organic cotton. OEKO-TEX® certified for human health. The Climate Label certified for reduced environmental impact. Certified B Corp for social and environmental accountability.
- Made with 92% Organic Cotton, 8% Spandex
- GOTS Certified Organic Cotton by Control Union, #1245496
- Mid-weight blend, 300 gsm
- Made from Organic Cotton with a touch of stretch, this fabric is soft, breathable, and designed to move with you. It offers close-to-body comfort with natural flexibility and a smooth, supportive feel against the skin.
- Machine wash cold with like colors, tumble dry low. Do not bleach.
- Made in India
Inseam All Sizes: 4"
*** Front Body length from is from top neck to crotch

-XS: F Body Length 18 1/2 Chest 26 1/4" Waist 22 1/2"
-S: F Body Length 19 Chest 28 1/4" Waist 24 1/2"
-M: F Body Length 19 1/2 Chest 30 1/4" Waist 26 1/2"
-L: F Body Length 20 1/8 Chest 32 1/4" Waist 28 1/2"
-XL: F Body Length 20 3/4 Chest 35 1/4" Waist 30 1/2"
The MATE Dress Code brings your values into each fiber and fabrication.

GOTS Certified Organic - Certified by the Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS) organically grown and responsibly processed, meeting strict environmental and social criteria that promote safer, fairer working conditions across the entire supply chain. GOTS supports reduced chemical use, healthier soil, and responsible water management for lower environmental impact.

Tested with OEKO-TEX® - Finished materials are certified to OEKO-TEX® Standard 100, meaning every component is tested for a wide range of harmful substances and verified safe for human use.
